role: District Representative · Agusan del Sur, 1st District
summary: Agusan del Sur 1st District representative with 57 principal-authored bills. Only one surfaced under rubric topics: a bill calling a constitutional convention to amend the 1987 Constitution. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Only one rubric-relevant bill surfaced from 57; a ConCon bill is a procedural route and not itself a sign of orientation.
